name: OGKB
summary: **OGKB** (OG Kush Breath) is a [[kind:cut|clone-only]] phenotype of [[gsc|Girl Scout Cookies]] first shared publicly in the early 2010s by a grower known online as OGKushBreath. It was further documented by NorCalKid alongside the [[gsc-forum-cut|Forum Cut]], and became a parent strain behind crosses such as [[do-si-dos|Do-Si-Dos]] and [[mendo-breath|Mendo Breath]]. Its exact origin within the Cookies breeding circle remains undocumented.

sources.title: OGKB Strain – Grow Guide & Genetics
